items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: He hired us on the OK record.

ctx.x: Pepe Prince on the drum. Willie Jackson on the baritone alto. James Jackson on the tenor. Eddie Davis on bass. And myself and Joe Liggins. That's all. Oh, yeah. I made them all. All the original ones. Oh, yeah. When did you make your first recording date? Oh, yeah. 1925 in Chicago. 1925? In which band?
I don't know, but a bunch of musicians that come hired us on an OK record. This guy's name was Richard. Richard Jones. Richard Jones.

The piano player. Richard M. Jones. Richard M. Jones, the piano player. Mickney? That's what his name. He hired us on the OK record. And you know which titles you made? No, it was a Dixieland thing. It was a Dixieland thing. Yeah. Did you have a special lead or just... No, I had to play the chords and me and the bass.
